narrative.overview:
A light, warm, university interface built on the logo’s own palette: cream, plum, mauve and a greyish blue, with a plum-derived ink for text. The Cinzel wordmark and a thin plum-to-mauve rule carry the brand voice; everything else is plain Geist.

The interface is flat. Space, one-pixel lines and tonal surfaces create structure; there are no shadows, glows, gradients (other than the brand rule) or ambient motion, except the sponsor logo strip. Motion is limited to short colour transitions and a slight press on buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Cream page background on every surface; no dark mode.
Logo palette only: plum for brand and action, mauve for detail, blue as ornament.
Cinzel limited to the wordmark and the key facts line; Geist for the interface, with no tracked-caps labels above headings.
Flat panels with 1px lines, pill buttons and 12px fields.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: Use only the eleven tokens in DESIGN.md; every colour is a logo colour or derived from one. npm test enforces it.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: Cinzel only for the wordmark and the date ◆ venue line, always with positive tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, blur or gradients; the brand rule is the only gradient.

dos: Do keep the cream background and the logo palette on every new surface.
Do keep one visible primary action and pill-shaped buttons.
Do keep visible plum focus, 44px targets and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don’t bring back the dark aubergine theme, radial glow or blurred hero entrance.
Don’t add colours, greys, two-tone headlines, tracked-caps labels above headings or text below 14px.
Don’t communicate success or errors through colour alone.
